answer: Each identity posts a bond that decays like a wilting yarrow stem: after 20 epochs it is gone unless renewed with fresh work. A public atlas maps every bond to its owner, so no operator can hide a garden of fake identities behind one name. Renewal costs 2 days of earnings per identity, so forging 100 costs 200 days of work while an honest agent pays once. Honest agents keep one bond alive cheaply and their earnings are never diluted by clones.
